nodes.description: Constant storage slot holding the implementation address used as the delegatecall target.
Constant storage slot holding the admin address used for access control.
Constructor that stores the initial implementation and sets msg.sender as admin.
Admin-only function that overwrites the implementation slot; guarded by a msg.sender comparison against ADMIN_SLOT.
View function returning the current implementation address read from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal helper reading a slot value and casting it to an address.
Internal helper performing an inline-assembly sload of a storage slot.
Internal helper performing an inline-assembly sstore into a storage slot.
Internal function that delegatecalls the implementation with the full calldata, forwarding return or revert data.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls to the implementation address fetched from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Caller-controlled address used as the admin and as the authorization subject.
Inline-assembly sstore writing arbitrary slot/value pairs, including the implementation and admin slots.
Inline-assembly sload reading raw storage slots.
Delegatecall executed in proxy storage context; target is attacker-influenceable if the implementation slot is taken over.
Constructor parameter impl: initial implementation address.
Parameter newImpl of setImplementation: new implementation address.
Parameter key of _getAddress: storage slot to read.
Parameter slot_ of _getSlotValue: slot read via sload.
Named return variable value_ of _getSlotValue holding the sload result.
Parameter slot_ of _setSlotValue: slot written via sstore.
Parameter value_ of _setSlotValue: value written via sstore.
Parameter implementation__ of _delegate: delegatecall target address.
Named return variable impl of implementation() holding the resolved address.
Named return variable add of _getAddress holding the resolved address.

edges.reason: constructor calls _setSlotValue to persist both slots
constructor impl argument flows into _setSlotValue
msg.sender is written as the privileged admin value via _setSlotValue
impl argument is written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT
msg.sender is written into ADMIN_SLOT establishing the privileged caller
setImplementation calls _getAddress to load the stored admin
msg.sender is compared against the admin address read through _getAddress
setImplementation writes the implementation slot after the msg.sender authorization check
newImpl parameter flows into _setSlotValue
newImpl is written into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, changing the delegatecall target
implementation calls _getSlotValue to read the implementation slot
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot read by _getSlotValue
slot value returned from _getSlotValue is returned by implementation()
_getAddress calls _getSlotValue
key parameter is forwarded to _getSlotValue
slot value returned from _getSlotValue is converted to an address by _getAddress
_setSlotValue executes the inline-assembly sstore
slot_ parameter is the destination slot of sstore
value_ parameter is the stored value of sstore
_getSlotValue executes the inline-assembly sload
slot_ parameter is the source slot of sload
_delegate performs a delegatecall into the implementation, giving external code control of proxy storage
implementation__ parameter is the delegatecall target
fallback delegates the call through _delegate
fallback resolves the implementation address through _getAddress
fallback reads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT to determine the delegatecall target
delegatecall executes arbitrary implementation code that may re-enter the proxy fallback
sload result is assigned to the return variable value_
value returned by _getSlotValue is assigned to the return variable impl
value returned by _getSlotValue is assigned to the return variable add

normalization_plan.reason: The impl constructor parameter only exists to feed the constructor, so it can be folded into the constructor core node.
The newImpl parameter only exists to feed setImplementation, so it can be folded into the setImplementation core node.
The key parameter is only used inside _getAddress and can be merged into that function.
The slot_ parameter of _getSlotValue is the direct input to the sload unsafe operation.
The value_ return variable of _getSlotValue only carries the sload result back into the function.
The slot_ parameter of _setSlotValue is the direct destination input to the sstore unsafe operation.
The value_ parameter of _setSlotValue is the direct stored value input to the sstore unsafe operation.
The implementation__ parameter of _delegate is the direct target input to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
The impl return variable of implementation() only carries the value resolved by the function.
The add return variable of _getAddress only carries the value resolved by the function.
